Season 4 episode guideEPISODE JOURNAL / THE GUIDE

About Episode Journal

A drama guide published by Webcraftio.

Episode Journal helps viewers find the correct episode, its original broadcast date and the subtitle edition they want. This first release focuses on Sultan Muhammad Fateh Season 4.

Who publishes this guide?

Episode Journal is published by Webcraftio. The publisher maintains episode records, verifies released viewing options and reviews story information against linked sources.

Visit Webcraftio

Our source policy

TRT is the primary external source for broadcast information, episode identity and official story summaries. Niazi TV is used for a secondary story check and subtitle edition links. Our own calendar brings the original dates and TRT schedule references together.

How we verify episodes

Our viewing recommendation

Great Nation is the publisher’s preferred free platform with notifications. It appears first, followed by Makki TV, Niazi TV and Historical Point. Ad and pop-up notes reflect the publisher’s experience.

Corrections and updates

We keep broadcast dates, webpage posting dates and subtitle availability separate. A verification date records a check, rather than inventing the upload time. Upcoming episodes remain upcoming until the released edition is confirmed.

Your saved preferences

The preference form currently stores your selection and email address on your device. Episode Journal email delivery and automatic monitoring are not connected. Great Nation has its own notification options.

Independent editorial guide

Episode Journal does not host full episodes or represent TRT. Series imagery belongs to TRT and the respective rights holders. Story details are original editorial summaries supported by the sources on each page.
